title: A Warm Night in the Ironing Room

sentences.text: My watch showed a warmth in the ironing room from 02:00 to 06:00.
The temperature was 22.4 °C, which was above the expected 21.2 °C.
This warmth, which had no source, was higher than the expected range of 20.8 °C to 21.6 °C.
Since the warmth had no source, perhaps it would be kind to check the heating in that room.
